core_meaning.short_meaning: Enduring firmness; Badri companion Murarah ibn al-Rabi' al-Amiri.
core_meaning.primary_meaning: Murarah (مُرَارَة) is a historic Arabic masculine name meaning 'enduring firmness', 'unbending resolution', or 'perseverance'. In Islamic history, it is the renowned name of Murarah ibn al-Rabi' al-Amiri al-Ansari, a veteran of Badr and one of the three truthful companions whose repentance and honesty were immortalized and forgiven by Allah in the Holy Qur'an.
core_meaning.literal_meaning: Derived from marrah (strength, firmness, and endurance), signifying unyielding moral resolve and steadfast character.
core_meaning.meaning_explanation: Murarah ibn al-Rabi' fought bravely at Badr and Uhud. When the expedition to Tabuk occurred, he lagged behind without hypocrisy, simply overtaken by hesitation. When the Prophet ﷺ returned, Murarah refused to make False excuses, choosing complete honesty. After fifty days of social boycott and heartfelt repentance, Allah sent down divine forgiveness in Surah at-Tawbah (9:118).
